contents.text: {"answer":"Engineering should first examine why the air bags did not deploy in the owner’s reported rear impact followed by impact with the box truck. Keep that separate from recall 24V064000, which concerns a front passenger seat weight sensor failing to suppress the air bag and unintended deployment, rather than nondeployment. The records do not establish the cause of the reported nondeployment.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11633527","quote":"hit me going at a very fast speed that forced my car into a box truck in front of me."},{"kind":"complaint","id":"11633527","quote":"Zero  airbags were deployed with either impact."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, failing to suppress the air bag as intended."},{"kind":"recall","id":"24V064000","quote":"An air bag that deploys unintentionally during a crash"}]}
